post.description: Polymarket resolution watch: markets ending within N days (default 7) with UMA resolution status (proposed/disputed), UMA bond and reward, hours to resolution, last price, 24h volume, liquidity and a uma_risk flag for contested or undecided resolutions. Lets prediction agents avoid or exploit resolution risk. No charge on service failure. Ed25519-signed. $0.10 USDC per call via x402 on Base. Free trial: 3 calls per wallet with header X-WALLET.
